name: ccmaf-skills
description: CCMAF Skills — production-grade, vendor-neutral skills for Claude Code and compatible agent runtimes, packaged as role/section packs plus an all-in-one plugin.

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills
plugins.description: All 102 CCMAF skills as one plugin. Every CCMAF skill as one plugin — senior-level engineering standards across languages, frameworks, cloud and operations, data, AI/agents, security and identity, plus agent-workflow and prose-quality disciplines and workspace skills for Claude working on your own machine. Prefer the role packs if you want a smaller skill listing.

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-core
plugins.description: Core — The agent-workflow disciplines every session benefits from: de-slopped prose, technical writing, docs-grounding, usage-limit hygiene, model calibration, systematic debugging, reviewable plans and recaps, committable diagrams, and the two shells. [Everyone — install this first.] (11 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-engineering
plugins.description: Engineering — The cross-cutting engineering disciplines: code review, secure development, test engineering, git workflow, architecture review, legacy modernisation, and Python as the general-purpose glue language. [Every developer, whatever the stack — install alongside core.] (7 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-workspace
plugins.description: Workspace — The safety disciplines every workspace agent needs: reversible system changes with a change journal, mail, web and tool output treated as data rather than instructions, bounded unattended scheduled runs, and authoring CCMAF-App workspace kits. [Anyone running Claude as an agent on their own machine — install alongside core for any workspace type.] (4 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-web
plugins.description: Web & UI — Building web UIs that look chosen and behave well: HTML/CSS/Tailwind craft, React and Next.js, TypeScript, design taste, UX reasoning, accessibility, render-and-critique verification, and web performance. [Frontend and full-stack developers building user interfaces.] (8 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-backend
plugins.description: Backend & APIs — Services and the contracts between them: HTTP and GraphQL API design, .NET, Go and Rust, relational SQL, identity and auth, and event-driven architecture. [Backend and full-stack developers building services and data access.] (8 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure & Operations — Running software in production: Azure, Terraform/OpenTofu, containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, observability, incident response, and Linux as both workstation and server. [Platform, DevOps and SRE engineers, and anyone who ships to production.] (9 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-microsoft
plugins.description: Microsoft Business Platforms — The Microsoft business-application stack: Power Apps and Automate, Power Pages, Dynamics 365/Dataverse pro-code, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 development, Fabric, Power BI, and Sentinel/KQL. [Developers and makers on Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 and Fabric.] (8 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-ai
plugins.description: AI & Machine Learning — Software built on models: LLM applications and agents on the Claude API, retrieval-augmented generation as an engineered component, and classic/deep machine learning you train yourself. [Engineers building on LLMs or training their own models.] (3 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-data
plugins.description: Data — Moving, shaping and analysing data: vendor-neutral batch and streaming pipelines, ELT/dbt, orchestration, lakehouse modelling, data quality and contracts, and everyday CSV-to-chart analysis for non-developers. [Data engineers and anyone moving or analysing data.] (2 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-apps
plugins.description: Desktop & Mobile Apps — Native and cross-platform apps: Electron, Tauri, native Windows UI (WPF/WinUI/WinForms/MAUI), Android with Kotlin and Compose, and iOS with Swift and SwiftUI. [Developers shipping desktop or mobile applications.] (5 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-games
plugins.description: Games & 3D — Games and interactive 3D: Godot (engine, shaders, MCP-driven workflow), Unity, Unreal Engine 5, three.js, and the engine-agnostic craft of game feel. [Game developers and real-time 3D engineers.] (7 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-creative
plugins.description: Creative & Media — Code-driven creative tooling and writing craft: Blender scripting and pipelines, ComfyUI image-generation workflows, programmatic video with Remotion, and fiction craft and revision. [Artists, technical artists, video makers and writers.] (4 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-research
plugins.description: Research — Research and learning done carefully: literature discovery, source appraisal, evidence synthesis and citation-safe referencing, source-traced research notes, and evidence-based study coaching. [Researchers, students and anyone who needs citation-safe sources.] (3 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-automation
plugins.description: Automation — Automating the web, the desktop and repetitive work responsibly: scrapers and crawlers with a legal/ethical gate first, agent-driven browser and computer-use loops with hard stops, and folder rules with dry runs and undo. [Anyone automating the web or repetitive work.] (4 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-system
plugins.description: Windows System Care — Looking after a Windows PC: day-to-day administration, plain-language crash and slowdown diagnostics, security hygiene with reversible quarantine, measured performance tuning, and the machine's setup captured as code. [Anyone looking after a Windows PC — their own or the household's.] (5 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-documents
plugins.description: Documents — Documents done properly: audience-first drafting and revision, editorial review with sourced fact-check flags, and Office/PDF handling routed to the dedicated format skills with versioned copies. [Anyone who drafts, edits or manages documents.] (3 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-assistant
plugins.description: Personal Assistant — A personal assistant that proposes and never acts unasked: an Obsidian-compatible knowledge vault, inbox triage, calendar help, a morning briefing, a commitments ledger, and care with personal data. [Anyone using Claude as a personal assistant over notes, mail and calendar.] (6 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-homelab
plugins.description: Homelab — Running a home server safely: SSH hygiene, Compose stacks, updates with rollback, NAS storage health and 3-2-1 backups with restore tests, and a lawful media-server stack. [Hobbyists running a home server, NAS or media stack.] (3 skills)

plugins.name: ccmaf-skills-life-admin
plugins.description: Life Admin — Household admin kept local: bank and card records normalised, categorised and budgeted, receipts and documents filed, renewals and warranties tracked, reminders drafted. Records, not advice. [Anyone keeping household paperwork and money records in order.] (2 skills)
